from common import *
import gzip,shutil
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urlparse,unquote
from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import scan_experiment_archives
from backtest.scripts.report.build_strategy_group_reports import load_catalog
class Links(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.refs=[];self.svg=0
 def handle_starttag(self,t,a):
  a=dict(a)
  if t in ['a','iframe','img'] and (a.get('href') or a.get('src')):self.refs.append(a.get('href') or a.get('src'))
  if t=='svg':self.svg+=1
if __name__=='__main__':
 source(__file__);harness('check')
 # Read-only review found only this precision issue: risk budget is not fixed exposure.
 for name in ['comparison.html','detail.html']:
  path=BT/'reports'/name;s=path.read_text();assert '100万、90%仓位' in s
  s=s.replace('100万、90%仓位','100万、risk_degree=0.90')
  path.write_text(s)
 audit=read(BT/'docs/registration-report-verification.json')
 audit['reports']=[fp(x['path']) for x in audit['reports']];write(BT/'docs/registration-report-verification.json',audit)
 scan=scan_experiment_archives(ROOT);assert not scan['errors'],scan['errors']
 snapshot,_=load_catalog(ROOT)
 selected=[r for r in snapshot['records'] if r['id'] in [MODEL_ID,BT_ID,'baseline/phase-m-v1-bt-v5']]
 assert len(selected)==3
 write(BT/'docs/platform-verification.json',{'selected_records':selected,'archive_errors':scan['errors']})
 paths=[MB/'reports/detail.html',BT/'reports/detail.html',BT/'reports/comparison.html',BT/'reports/ladder-account.html',BT/'reports/s5-account.html',ROOT/'backtest/experiments/reports/phase_m_v1_report.html',ROOT/'backtest/experiments/reports/phase_m_v1_bt_report.html']
 checks=[]
 for p in paths:
  parser=Links();parser.feed(p.read_text());valid=[]
  for ref in parser.refs:
   u=urlparse(ref)
   if u.scheme or not u.path:continue
   q=(p.parent/unquote(u.path)).resolve();assert q.is_file(),(p,ref,q);valid.append(str(q))
  checks.append({'report':fp(p),'local_links_checked':len(valid),'svg_count':parser.svg})
 write(BT/'docs/final-review.json',{'independent_review':'review_v5_promotion: no critical/important blockers; independently recomputed all full/year/style metrics; 51 detail/hub links valid. Minor risk-degree wording corrected.','checks':checks,'visual_preview':'Not performed: browser security rejected file protocol. No workaround attempted. Static HTML structure/local links/embedded SVG presence checked.','remaining_scientific_limitations':['Historical selection window, not independent out-of-sample.','v5 under fixed-s5 does not improve historical s5; model head-metric promotion does not imply account improvement.','No automated v5 strategy result gate; explicit manual verification used.']})
 for rule in ['ladder','s5']:
  raw=TMP/f'{rule}.log';dest=BT/'docs'/f'{rule}-account.log.gz'
  with raw.open('rb') as inp,gzip.open(dest,'wb') as out:shutil.copyfileobj(inp,out)
  assert gzip.decompress(dest.read_bytes())==raw.read_bytes()
 for name in ['cleanup-dryrun.json','cleanup-final-dryrun.json']:shutil.copyfile(TMP/name,BT/'docs'/name)
 dry=read(BT/'docs/cleanup-final-dryrun.json')
 assert not dry['errors'] and not dry['delete_result_dirs'] and not dry['delete_mlruns_dirs']
 state=read(PROGRESS);assert state['status']=='completed' and all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs'])
 kept=set(dry['keep_result_dirs'])
 ml=[]
 for job in state['jobs']:
  session=ROOT/job['session'];assert str(session) in kept
  link=read(session/'run_01/mlruns_link.json');rec=ROOT/link['backtest_artifacts']
  files=[fp(p) for p in sorted(rec.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
  assert files and any('report_normal_1day.pkl' in f['path'] for f in files)
  ml.append({'recorder':str(rec.relative_to(ROOT)),'files':files,'retained_reason':'Registered platform experiment original account/position/indicator evidence. source_report fingerprints and mlruns_link reference this exact recorder; retain required originals. No transient predictions or trained model copied into recorder.'})
 manifest=read(MB/'configs/model-manifest.json')
 for c in manifest['components']:
  assert str(ROOT/'backtest/result'/c['session']) in kept
  for key in ['model','prediction','training']:check(c[key])
 check(manifest['ensemble'])
 write(BT/'docs/retention-verification.json',{'result_dry_run':fp(BT/'docs/cleanup-final-dryrun.json'),'delete_result_dirs':[],'new_sessions_retained':[j['session'] for j in state['jobs']],'five_v5_models_preserved':True,'prediction_dependency_preserved':True,'new_mlruns':ml,'mlruns_disposition':'Required registered originals retained after exact ownership/reference audit; no new unreferenced recorders. only-result alone was not used as MLflow evidence.','historical_warning_count':len(dry['warnings']),'historical_warnings_scope':'Pre-existing missing historical sources recorded by official dry-run; no reconstruction or deletion in this task.'})
 # Preserve every temporary executable source, including failed preflight and reporting adapters.
 for p in sorted(TMP.glob('*.py')):source(p)
 subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
 harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Independent review and numerical/HTML-link/platform checks passed. 50 cohort tests passed. Browser file-URL visual preview blocked by security policy; recorded limitation. Official platform cleanup dry-run has zero errors and zero deletion targets; required new recorder originals and five v5 models verified.'})
 harness('event',{'type':'stop','reason':'hypotheses_exhausted'})
 print('Ready for task-local cleanup; actual 2/2 accounts, 0 new fits; scientific and registry/report work complete.')
